Frequently Asked Questions (Etsy vs TikTok Shop)

Which has lower base fees in 2026: Etsy or TikTok Shop US?

TikTok Shop US has a lower organic base fee (6% referral vs. Etsy’s ~9.5% + $0.45), but TikTok creator affiliate commissions (10%–20%) quickly exceed Etsy fees unless you bundle orders above $40.

Can I fulfill both Etsy and TikTok Shop orders automatically?

Yes! POD platforms like Printify integrate with Etsy, TikTok Shop US, and Shopify simultaneously, and Printify Premium lowers blank costs by up to 20% across all channels.
